title: Developer Portfolio
description: Static-first React portfolio built on a custom design system, with content edited through a React Admin panel, stored in MongoDB, and compiled into committed static JSON at every build - delivering zero-latency reads with no runtime API dependency on the live site.

title: GloTechT
description: GloTechT is an "English-French Glossary of Terms Related to Disruptive Technologies (Big Data • AI • Blockchain)". GloTechT is part of the thesis of an international linguist, for a PhD in Linguistics at Dalhousie University (Halifax, NS, Canada). It results with an 80% approval rating from the thesis committee.

title: PayLite
description: PayLite is a real-time fintech dashboard platform featuring a secure digital wallet, transaction engine, and admin panel. It's designed for scalability and low-latency operations, the system supports 10k+ users with ACID-safe transactions, JWT-secured APIs, and optimized PostgreSQL queries.

title: Jobacker - AI job application copilot
description: An end-to-end job search assistant that scores your resume against any job description, generates tailored cover letters and ATS-optimized resumes, and tracks every application through a Kanban pipeline - in one place.

title: Lingora
description: A production-grade translation service with a fallback architecture. Lingora chains three translation engines - Gemini AI (primary), DeepLX, and LibreTranslate - so when one provider degrades or times out, the next takes over automatically. Users get one thing: a clean, correctly-translated answer, every time. No dead-end errors, no provider lock-in.

title: Abibi Meublés
description: A full-stack platform for managing and booking furnished apartment rentals for a client in Douala (Cameroon), with a customer-facing booking flow and an admin back-office. Engineered a 5-step booking system with real-time availability checks, guest info collection; walked customers from apartment discovery (interactive Leaflet map + filters) through confirmation, with PDF receipt generation, WhatsApp support, and email notifications. Delivered an admin dashboard for managing apartments, reservations, and clients behind JWT-based role-gated routes.
